title: Deep Time: From Steno to Radiometric Dating
learningObjectives: Explain how Steno's laws of superposition establish relative geologic time
Describe Hutton's uniformitarianism and its implication of vast time
Understand how radioactivity discovery enabled absolute radiometric dating

explanations.text: Early stratigraphy showed rock layers record relative time with older layers below younger ones.

evidence.quote: The law of superposition says that older rocks are on the bottom and younger rocks are on the top.

explanations.text: The discovery of radioactivity provided a heat source and a clock for measuring absolute ages via half-lives.

evidence.quote: It was the discovery of radioactivity in 1896 that changed the heat-flow picture dramatically.
A half-life is the length of time it takes for half of the number of original, or parent, isotopes to decay to a stable daughter isotope.
